_comment: Textures for materials the matcher cannot reach, and the interchangeable sets they belong to. texture_overrides.json is keyed on the texture stem an FBX asks for; this file is keyed on the FBX's own material name, which is the only handle on a material whose bitmap path was emptied before export. 'flavors' groups textures a pack ships as alternatives for one surface, either tileable variants of a surface or recolours of one atlas. 'bind' says which materials fall back to which set, matched on the model filename stem and on the material name, both optional. Those two are whole-name globs anchored at the start, so 'Wall*' means a material name beginning with Wall; this is deliberately unlike the 'flavors' member patterns above, which match the tail of a pack-relative path. Bindings are tried in order, first match wins, and only ever fill a channel that resolved to nothing. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Run --scan-materials --scan-report to see what is still bare in your own packs.

PolygonFantasyKingdom._verification: Every binding below the first three was decided by importing the FBX in Blender, reading the mesh's own UV bounds, and sampling PolygonFantasyKingdom_01_A at those coordinates. Two patterns separate the atlas from the tileable Castle textures cleanly. A material whose UVs run past 1.0, typically V 1.00 to 1.99, is tiled onto a repeating surface and belongs to Wall; that is what SM_Bld_Castle_Wall_Block_01 to _05, the six SM_Bld_Castle_Wall_Cut_* and SM_Bld_Castle_Wall_03 to _05 all do, matching the V range of SM_Bld_Stairs_Round_M_Base_01, whose material really is called Wall. A material confined to a small island inside 0 to 1 is atlas mapped, and sampling names the colour it was authored with: SM_Wep_Sceptre_02 draws gold 187,141,74 with a red gem 112,50,44, SM_Bld_Castle_Hoarding_Wood_Wall_01 draws three timber browns, SM_Prop_Gazebo_01 draws one flat 111,79,58 wood. Several cases have an exact twin that kept its binding. This pack ships every corpse twice, once as SM_Dead_* with the material stripped and once as SM_Prop_Dead_*: SM_Dead_Knight_01 and SM_Prop_Dead_Knight_01 have the same 6140 loops, the same U 0.014 to 0.254 V 0.007 to 0.736, and both sample steel 133,137,141, and SM_Prop_Dead_Knight_01 resolves to the atlas on its own. SM_Dead_Horse_04 and SM_Prop_Dead_Horse_04 share 2512 loops and produce an identical colour histogram against Horse_01.png, which is what SM_Prop_Dead_Horse_04 resolves to. SM_Prop_Chair_Fancy_01 and _02 span the same island and sample the same gold and red. SM_Bld_Castle_Hoarding_Corner_L_01 and _M_01 span U 0.1516 to 0.4891 V 0.1555 to 0.6653, identical to Corner_S_01, which resolves. SM_Env_Bush_Cluster_01, _04, _05 and _06 span the same island as _02 and _03 and sample the same 71,83,56 green, so their PolygonApocalypse_Texture_01_Cleaned.psd reference is an artist's working file name rather than a real dependency. The SM_Bld_Preset_*_Optimized bodies span U 0.007 to 0.995 V 0.006 to 0.993, the footprint that identified the presets in the first place. Cases with no twin were checked against a UV coverage map built from 200 models that do resolve to the atlas: SM_Bld_Castle_Battlements_*_04, SM_Bld_Castle_Wall_Door_Big_01, SM_Prop_Gazebo_01 and SM_Prop_Hanging_Clothes_04 land 200 of 200 sampled points inside it. Flags are the one set whose choice is genuinely the consumer's: 21 SM_Prop_Flag_* models carry a single material naming Symbols.psd, which never shipped, and the 16 flags that did ship are one 1024 layout with the emblem centred and a pole, rope and timber swatch strip in the bottom left corner. SM_Prop_Flag_01 samples the white emblem and the blue field, while SM_Prop_Flag_18 to _20 and SM_Prop_Flag_Wall_Attachment_01 sit entirely in that swatch strip. Only the bottom row, V about 0.010, where SM_Prop_Flag_Wall_Attachment_01 sits, is pixel identical across all 16, the pole sampling 54, 59, 63 and the rope 83, 81, 81 exactly; the rest of the strip, V 0.010 to 0.039, which SM_Prop_Flag_18 to _20 cover, is the flag field colour, which differs across colour families, mean absolute difference 0.000 within a family and 26.4 to 65.0 across them. That difference is exactly the choice a consumer of a flavor set makes, so one 16 member set still stands, if anything better supported than before. Flag_Lion_01_Blue is the default because the crowned lion on teal is also the tile the pack's own atlas carries.
PolygonFantasyKingdom._uncertain: Twelve SM_Bld_Castle_Pillar_Stone_* models share the material lambert22 and split down the middle: _03, _04, _Half_02, _Half_03, _Round_01 and _Round_02 sample the atlas's light stone 156,144,124 and sit inside its resolved coverage, while _01, _02, _Half_01, _Round_03, _05 and _05_Half either run past V 1.0 or scatter across unrelated swatches. Neither Wall nor Atlas is right for all twelve and no per model rule is defensible, so the family stays bare. The five SM_Bld_Castle_DestroyedWall_Rubble* pieces collapse to a single UV point: RubblePile_01 lands on stone grey 113,113,113, but Rubble_Top, _Middle and _Bottom land on 0,0,0 in the black padding along the atlas's bottom edge, and RubbleBlock_01 sits at V 1.1366. The seven flat wall pieces of that family tile normally and are bound; the rubble is not. FX_Sphere_03 samples one flat 113,113,113 and its sibling FX_Sphere does resolve to the atlas, but the point falls outside the coverage map and it is a single FX model, so it is left alone. Everything else still bare in this pack was never meant to carry a texture: the fountain water, the cloud ring, the two generic water planes, SM_Particle_Smoke_01, SunShafts, the candle flame and the flame cards of FX_Item_Candlestick_* and FX_Prop_Chandelier_*, all of which are one to thirty six loops spanning the whole of UV space.

POLYGON_Nature_Source_Files_v2._verification: The trees in this pack keep Trunk and Leave as separate materials on separate surfaces, so each half can be bound by name. Trunk means two different things and the UVs say which. On Pine, Willow, Generic and Dead trees the whole trunk collapses to a single UV point, which can only be a palette lookup: SM_Tree_Pine_01 sits at 0.168, 0.621 and samples PolygonNature_01 at 107,92,72, the same bark swatch the resolved SM_Tree_Pine_Base_01 reads at 0.180, 0.592, and SM_Tree_Dead_03 at 0.318, 0.602 samples 73,56,46, the swatch the resolved SM_Tree_Pine_Dead_01 reads at 0.315, 0.600. On the live birches the trunk is instead a real grid unwrap over the whole square, U 0.000 to 1.000 V 0.004 to 0.981 across 41 distinct face boxes, and Birch_Trunk_Texture.png is the pack's only full frame tileable bark and is bound by no model. Leave splits three ways by family. The six pines share six face boxes inside U 0.234 to 0.788, a centred band 0.554 wide, which is exactly where the conifer sprig sits in Leaves_Pine_Texture.png. Every willow leaf face is a single full square card, which only the full square willow drape fits. Birch and Generic have byte identical Leave layouts, five boxes split at V 0.429 and U 0.813, and Leaves_Generic_Texture.png is the only broadleaf cluster card shipped and is otherwise orphaned. Leaves_Dead is a different layout again, a 2 by 2 quadrant split, and Tree_Dead_Branch.png is the only bare branch card. SM_Plant_Bush_Leaves_03's Tree2 has exactly SM_Tree_Generic_01's Leave layout, 24 instanced full cards. PolygonNature_01 through _04 are one atlas recoloured: their colour discontinuity edge maps agree 100 percent.
POLYGON_Nature_Source_Files_v2._uncertain: The four River_Plane_* models are water and stay bare. Ground_Textures/Leaves.png and its _02 to _04 siblings really are four interchangeable recolours of one tileable leaf litter ground surface, and Grass_Textures/Grass_01 to _04 are four grass card variants, but no FBX in this pack has a bare ground or grass material, so neither would carry a binding and neither is declared. Worth a separate look: SM_Plant_Bush_Leaves_01 and _02, SM_Plant_Fern_* and SM_Plant_Undergrowth_01 are not bare but are almost certainly mis-resolved. They name a stale working path ending PolygonNature.png, which the matcher maps to the 512 pixel palette PolygonNature_01.png, while their UVs are full square alpha cards, so they render as confetti today. Their real textures, Leaves_Generic_Texture.png, Fern_Texture.png and Undergrowth_Texture.png, all ship and are orphaned. This file cannot reach them because their albedo already resolves; that is a texture_overrides.json job.

POLYGON_NatureBiomes_AridDesert_SourceFi._verification: The eleven Alts recolours agree with PolygonNatureBiomesS2_AridDesert_Texture_01 on 99.98 to 100 percent of their edge maps, so they are one atlas in twelve palettes. The bindings are anchored on resolved siblings. The eight bare SM_Prop_Bones_* materials sit at U 0.355 to 0.362 V 0.120 to 0.154, and SM_Prop_Bones_06, whose Nature_Base_Mat4 resolves to the arid atlas, sits at U 0.355 to 0.361 V 0.125 to 0.154; one of the bare ones is literally named PolygonNatureBiomesS2_Alpine_Texture_01, a wrong biome placeholder. SM_Env_Rock_Cliff_16 sits at U 0.324 to 0.327 V 0.127 to 0.130 and its fifteen resolved siblings _01 to _15 all sit at U 0.324 to 0.327 V 0.126 to 0.130. SM_Env_Bush_Bramble_01's bare lambert2 has the identical bounding box, U 0.050 to 0.933 V 0.030 to 0.998, to the lambert9 on the same model that resolves to Branches_01.tga. SM_Env_Succulent_05's bare lambert13 spans U 0.040 to 0.964 over 44 face boxes against the 43 boxes of the SucculentLeaves_MAT02 on the same model that resolves to Succulent_Leaves_Diffuse_PNGTEMP.png. SM_Env_Succulent_03 spans U 0.005 to 0.916 over 193 boxes against the resolved SM_Env_Succulent_04's U 0.005 to 0.941 over 198. Cactus_01.tga is the pack's only cactus body sheet, four pads and a spine star, and rendering SM_Env_Cactus_01 with it gives a barrel cactus with orange spines where the atlas gives confetti.
POLYGON_NatureBiomes_AridDesert_SourceFi._uncertain: Succulent_Leaves_03_.tga was deliberately left out of the SucculentLeaves set. Its alpha columns are up to 0.09 in UV away from the other two, and it is already the resolved texture for SM_Env_Succulent_01 and _02 over a different UV region, so including it would generate mis-registered swap variants. Everything else still bare here is excluded by kind: the sulphur pools, the pool and plane water, the fog ring, the skydome, the sun shafts and the smoke particle. lambert2024 was checked rather than assumed: its twelve faces span U 0.017 to 0.983 V 0.017 to 0.983, the same signature as SM_Env_Pool_Water_01, so it is the pool water plane.

POLYGON_NatureBiomes_MeadowForest_Source._verification: PolygonNatureBiomes_Meadow_Texture_01 and its _Saturated sibling agree on 99.88 percent of their edge maps, so they are one atlas in two grades. Explorer_MAT44, _45, _46 and _48, on the sword, the sword in the stone, the broken wagon and the well, all sit in U 0.007 to 0.263 V 0.006 to 0.358, the same atlas block as the resolved Explorer_MAT on SM_Bld_Stone_Cabin_01 and Explorer_MAT2 and _3 on the windmills, and rendering gives a stone well with a wood roof and a steel sword with a gold hilt. The bare SM_Env_Wildflowers_* materials are flat shaded flower geometry rather than cards: 258 faces of SM_Env_Wildflowers_01 sit on the single point U 0.369 V 0.207. SM_Env_Sunflower_01 puts 510 faces on U 0.413 V 0.150 and 256 on U 0.209 V 0.327 while its card material already resolves to Sunflower_01.tga, so the bare half is the stem and leaves. CropField_01.tga unambiguously depicts rapeseed, yellow four petal clusters on tall green stems, and its three alpha columns contain the clump mesh's three UV columns exactly. SM_Env_Background_Hill_01 is UV mapped U minus 4.799 to 5.799 V minus 2.367 to 3.367, roughly a 10 by 6 tile, which only a tileable ground texture can serve.
POLYGON_NatureBiomes_MeadowForest_Source._uncertain: SM_Env_CropField_Clump_01 and _02 are left bare. They share one mesh and one UV set with the rapeseed clumps, so UV cannot separate them, and Wheat_01.tga's alpha columns do not line up with that UV set. Binding them to the wheat card would rest on elimination plus a clean render, not on positive evidence, so they stay bare and the Wheat set is not declared. The sun shafts, fog ring, leaf particle, skydome, butterfly and water plane are excluded by kind.

POLYGON_NatureBiomes_TropicalJungle_Sour._verification: All eight bare fern materials share U 0.352 to 0.970 V 0.027 to 0.954, which is columns two and three of a three column card whose gaps sit at 0.309 to 0.358 and 0.643 to 0.689, exactly the measured column gaps of Leaf_Fern_01.tga, and that card is otherwise orphaned. The banana trees split by object: Leaf5 is on the objects named Leaves_LOD0 and _LOD1 across all four models and lands on the same two of three columns of Leaf_Banana_01.tga. Only SM_Env_Tree_Banana_04 has a dedicated trunk material, trunk2, 68 faces at U 0.3616 to 0.6384, the middle column of the atlas, matching the pack's own baked LOD_Cards/treeBanana_01.tga, whose trunk is light tan with darker horizontal bands, and Palm_Bark_01.png is the only tileable light tan horizontally ridged bark shipped. SM_Env_Tree_Banana_01 to _03 instead bind lambert21, lambert22 and lambert23, one 301 face material spanning U 0.3521 to 0.9703 and V 0.0145 to 0.9783, the union of the trunk column, the leaf columns and the LOD2 billboard quad, 233 of those 301 faces leaves, so PalmBark is narrowed to _04 alone and _01 to _03 stay bare. The rest are anchored to the pack atlas by a resolved neighbour or by landing on a painted region of it. SM_Env_Vines_01 and _02 sit at U 0.390 V 0.127 to 0.131 while the resolved _03, _04 and _05 sit at U 0.390 to 0.392 V 0.107 to 0.130. SM_Prop_Raft_01 spans U 0.015 to 0.050 V 0.245 to 0.357 and the resolved SM_Prop_Raft_Oar_01 sits inside it. SM_Prop_Plank_01, _02 and _04 at U 0.887 to 0.933 and _03 at U 0.761 to 0.812 land exactly on the two painted wood logs in the atlas; the docks straddle those same logs and the palette grid. The driftwood, tiki torches, rum bottle, message bottle scroll and rope bridge all sit in the atlas palette block that the pack's resolved props use, and sampling returns the colours those props are made of.
POLYGON_NatureBiomes_TropicalJungle_Sour._uncertain: SM_Env_Bush_Palm_01 to _04 and SM_Env_Bush_Palm_01_Flowers_01 span all three columns of a leaf card, U 0.005 to 0.970, so column one of every candidate, which is always the brown dead variant, would land on live leaves. Leaf_Square_01, Leaf_Detailed_01, Leaf_Palm_01 and Leaf_Fan_01 all render as coherent but different bushes and the pack's own LOD_Cards/bush_palm_01.tga shows an all green bush that none of them reproduces. Four plausible candidates and no discriminator, so they stay bare. SM_Env_Flower_01 to _03 use only the middle column, U 0.360 to 0.640, and all five three column leaf cards have their middle column within 0.01 of that, so the UV test is blind there too. SM_Env_Tree_Palm_01 to _04 have one material covering the trunk, the fronds and the LOD3 billboard on the same mesh, so no single shipped texture can be right for it. SM_Env_Tree_Banana_01 to _03 carry one material over the trunk, the leaves and the LOD2 billboard together, so no single shipped texture is right for them, exactly as the palms do. The waterfall, water plane, fog ring, skydome, sun shafts, leaf particle, bird, crab and the message bottle's Glass_MAT are excluded by kind.

POLYGON_SciFi_City_SourceFiles_v5._verification: Each of the eighteen neon signs asks for Neon_Animation.psd, which never shipped, and has U pinned to one narrow value while V spans a distinct band: SM_Sign_Neon_01 is U 0.008 V 0.011 to 0.039, SM_Sign_Neon_09 is U 0.007 to 0.010 V 0.154 to 0.282. That is the signature of reading a horizontal colour band strip, which is exactly what NeonSigns.png is, and each SM_Sign_Neon_NN has the same bounds as its SM_Sign_Neon_Flat_NN twin. Sampling returns pure neon primaries: 0,255,223 and 255,0,222 and 111,255,0. The ad signs ask for Signs_Emission.psd; SM_Sign_Ad_32 carries the same lambert288 as the bare SM_Sign_Ad_20 and resolves to Signs_01.png at U 0.003 to 0.247 V 0.128 to 0.247, and all 32 ad signs sit on the same 0.248, 0.497, 0.746 grid, sampling high chroma multicolour panels. The background buildings ask for Building_Window_Emissive.psd and the pack ships exactly one match, a 5 by 9 grid of lit window strips on black; their UVs tile vertically past 1.0, SM_Bld_Background_Lrg_01 running V minus 1.705 to 1.882 with U confined to 0.172 to 0.820, which is a repeating window band up a tower face and rules out an atlas island. The strip club interiors share the material name lambert1 with SM_Bld_StripClub_01 and _Interior_01 and _03, which resolve to PolygonScifi_01_A.png, and the bare _Interior_02's UVs nest inside _Interior_01's; sampling gives 174,95,168 magenta on the curtain and sofa. SM_Props_Shelves_01 overlaps the resolved SM_Prop_Medical_Chair_01's atlas island and samples 52,52,52 shelf metal, where the rival Billboards.png would give poster blue.
POLYGON_SciFi_City_SourceFiles_v5._uncertain: The lead that named PolygonSciFiSpace_Signs_Texture_01_A to _F was rejected outright: those files ship only in PolygonSciFiSpace, and a set's members are resolved against one pack's own texture list, so a cross pack member cannot be written here at all. Three of the nine neon signs, _03, _06 and _09, land on black texels because their sign is off in the animation strip's first frame; the texture is certainly right and a static converter simply freezes one frame. The background buildings will render near black with lit windows, because the emissive window sheet is 84 to 91 percent black. That is the authored night skyline look, but it is a large visual change and worth knowing about. Left bare: FX_Circle, FX_Plane_Simple, Flame_Mesh, SphereGeo, SphereInverted, SM_LightRayCube and SM_Particle_Smoke_01. The Atlas set is kept to the six PolygonScifi_01_? recolours rather than all 24 shipped alternates, because 01_A is what every resolved material in the pack uses.

PolygonSciFiSpace._verification: SM_Veh_EscapePod_Small_01's SciFi material resolves to PolygonSciFiSpace_Texture_01_A.png at U 0.236 to 0.454 V 0.028 to 0.384, which nests inside the bare Large pod's U 0.174 to 0.456 V 0.027 to 0.473, and both sample the same hull palette of 118,118,123 and 82,82,87 plus the 0,255,222 cyan glow. SM_Bld_Lift_01 sits on that same atlas island at U 0.234 to 0.452 V 0.027 to 0.384 and samples the standard hull greys, and its sibling SM_Bld_Lift_Wall_01 resolves to PolygonSciFiSpace_03_A.png, another member of the same recolour family.
PolygonSciFiSpace._uncertain: This pack has almost no defensible bare surface: 32 of its 34 bare materials are planets, glass, cockpit glass, screens, energy blades, FX spheres and a tunnel. The planets were checked rather than assumed. SM_Env_Planet_01 to _14 UV the full 0 to 1 of a sphere and the pack ships only Planet_Cloud_01_Mask, Planet_Land_01_Mask and PolygonSciFiSpace_PlanetLines_01, which are shader masks rather than albedos. SM_Env_PlanetRings_01 looks like a name match for PolygonScifi_PlanteRings_01.png, but that file's RGB plane is entirely white with the ring shape in alpha, and a flavor fill sets albedo only, so binding it would give a solid white disc. PolygonScifiSpace_Material_Dirt_01 on SM_Bld_Hangar_01 similarly names a white grunge overlay meant to multiply, not a base colour. lambert1 is genuinely ambiguous in this pack, resolving to Texture_01_A 21 times and to Signs_Texture_01_B 47 times, so the remaining lambert1 models are left alone.

POLYGON_BattleRoyale_Source_Files_v4._verification: lambert1 resolves to PolygonBattleRoyale_Texture_01_A.png on 107 other materials in this pack, and the character attachments that kept their binding, SM_Chr_Attach_Beard_*, _Earmuffs and _Eyepatch, all use it. SM_Chr_Attach_Pouch_08 spans U 0.113 to 0.786 V 0.251 to 0.446 against the resolved SM_Char_Attach_Bag_Lvl1's U 0.113 to 0.918 V 0.253 to 0.427, and sampling gives exactly the right colours: brass 209,164,76 with leather 97,70,55 on the ammo pouch, olive canvas 85,86,65 on the bedroll. The rubble piles ask for PolygonWar_Texture_GoodVersion.psd and sample a uniform concrete 123,106,90 on the pack atlas. SM_Prop_TankTrap_01 and SM_Env_Bridge_Support_01 have degenerate single point UVs that read 79,79,78 steel and 91,92,93 concrete, which is what a steel hedgehog and a bridge pier are made of. lambert10 resolves to Wep_Skin_01.png on six other SM_Wep_* models, and SM_Wep_Ammo_BulletLarge_01's UV samples identically on Wep_Skin_01 and Wep_Skin_07, so the choice of default inside that set does not matter.
POLYGON_BattleRoyale_Source_Files_v4._uncertain: SM_Env_Rubble_Plank_01 to _03 are left bare. They ask for Dungeons_Texture_01.png, which is a file the Dungeon Pack ships, and a flavor set's members are pack relative so that cannot be expressed here; sampling the BattleRoyale atlas at their UVs does give plank browns, but the right fix is a cross pack entry in texture_overrides.json. The level 2 armour is also left bare. The tier scheme runs Lvl1 to Texture_01_B and Lvl3 to Texture_01_C, so Lvl2 wants a Texture_01_D that never shipped, and 01_A, _B and _C differ in only 1.3 percent of their pixels but that difference sits inside U 0.000 to 0.350 V 0.156 to 0.391, which the armour UVs do cross, so the choice would visibly change the tier tint. That affects _Level3 on Characters and on the two SK_Chr_Attach_*_Armor_02 models, and Level2 on SM_Char_Attach_Bag_Lvl2. Nine glass materials, DamageZone, FX_Bullet_Trail and the smoke particle are excluded by kind.

POLYGON_Military_SourceFiles_v4._verification: The vehicle bindings rest on the pack's own convention plus a UV match. SM_Veh_Jet_Destroyed_01's bounds, U minus 0.344 to 1.112 V 0.002 to 0.997, are exactly the intact SM_Veh_Jet_01's, whose lambert888 resolves to Air_Vehicle_Master_01.png, and every other destroyed aircraft in the pack uses Air_Vehicle_Burnt.png. SM_Veh_Tank_USA_Destroyed_01 asks for Land_Vehicle_Master_Destroyed_01.psd and every other destroyed land vehicle, 21 materials of them, uses Land_Vehicle_Master_Burnt_01.png. The material name AircraftSHD resolves to Air_Vehicle_Master_01.png on five models, four of which are the attack helicopter's own attachments. The material name Vehicles resolves to Land_Vehicle_Master_01.png on 31 materials including every other part of SM_Veh_Truck_01. Air_Vehicle_Master_01 and the three Veh_Heli_01_? liveries share a colour swatch block at U 0 to 0.30 V 0 to 0.32 that is pixel near identical, mean absolute difference 2 to 7 of 255, while the burnt sheet differs by 62, which is what proves the liveries are one UV family and the burnt one a separate surface. Six of the eleven camo net materials ask for NettingTest.tga and are the ones whose UVs tile, SM_Bld_CamoNet_Tent_05 running U minus 0.128 to 4.139 V 0.072 to 4.601, and PolygonMilitary_Camo_Netting_01 and _02 are the only tileable netting shipped; the other five sit on one degenerate atlas texel reading 107,87,63 khaki canvas. The remaining props are each anchored on a material on the same model, or a numbered sibling, that resolves to PolygonMilitary_Texture_01_A.png over an overlapping UV box, and each samples the colour the prop is made of: 131,110,76 cartridge brass, 131,106,76 sandbag tan, 136,97,70 vase glaze, 150,130,108 sand. Four more bind the same way, on lambert1709 on SM_Bld_Tent_Sandbags_01, lambert2215 on SM_Prop_Powerpole_03 and MilitarySHD88 on SM_Prop_Gold_Plates_Preset_05, each anchored on a second material on the same model that already resolves to the atlas; lambert256 on SM_Prop_Sign_Poster_05 binds to the pack's own Signs 1.png instead: the bound material is 46 faces of frame geometry at U 0.604 to 0.937, V 0.740 to 0.974, overlapping the same model's own poster quad at U 0.626 to 0.998, V 0.755 to 0.999. Signs 1.png is not orphaned, it already has 21 resolving users including SM_Prop_Sign_Poster_01 through _06 and this model's own lambert2280; this is a same-model anchor, which is weaker evidence than a direct match.
POLYGON_Military_SourceFiles_v4._uncertain: The twelve FX_Decal_Bullet_* materials are a provably correct mapping that is deliberately not made: they ask for holes_Diffuse_Atlas.png and the pack ships exactly one Bullet_Decal_Atlas_D.png, but bullet decals need the alpha channel a flavor fill does not touch. The five blood pools are the same story, and both would be better served by texture_overrides.json. The camo netting will render as an opaque draped tarp rather than a net, for the same reason. Six glass materials are excluded by kind. The pack also ships per-vehicle liveries, Veh_Heli_01_A/B/C, Veh_Jet_01_A through _E, Veh_Jet_02_A through _E and Air_Veh_Large_01/02, which are deliberately not offered as swaps in AirVehicle, because they are specific to one airframe rather than alternative palettes of a shared atlas.

POLYGON_Dungeon_Pack_SourceFiles_v3._verification: SM_Env_Tiles_Texture_01 to _08 all use lambert2 on a small atlas island, 01 sitting at U 0.672 to 0.992 V 0.672 to 0.992. Only _09 and _10 use lambert605, and their UVs cover the whole quad, U 0.003 to 0.997 V 0.003 to 0.997, which means a dedicated full frame texture rather than an atlas lookup. The pack ships exactly two dedicated seamless floor tile sets, four recolours each, and they are numbered _09_ and _10_, matching the two model numbers one to one. The two sets are genuinely different patterns: within set edge correlation is 0.998 to 0.999 and across sets it is 0.19. These are the only bare materials in the pack.

POLYGON_Dungeons_Realms_SourceFiles_v5._verification: The camp platforms span U 0.036 to 0.373 V 0.277 to 0.380, and SM_Prop_Camp_Stick_01 and SM_Prop_Camp_Wood_Floor_04 both resolve to Dungeons_2_Texture_01_A.png at the single point U 0.373 V 0.380, precisely that box's corner, sampling the same 95,84,71 plank brown. SM_Prop_Barrel_01 sits at U 0.016 to 0.058 V 0.228 to 0.284 next to the resolved SM_Prop_Barrel_02's U 0.014 to 0.082 V 0.277 to 0.330 and samples one of the colours _02 reads.
